title: GERPACYST- A German Pancreasclub Cyst Registry
summary: This multi center interdisciplinary prospective registry trial aims to identify a risk prediction model to calculate the individual‘s risk of malignant pancreatic cyst progression. A secondary aim is to standardize radiological pancreatic protocols in order to be able to compare imaging data across Germany.

interventions.name: Patient and cyst characteristics will be documented for patients with pancreatic cyst (s) within their regular follow-ups. This will be continued for 20 years or until death or other reason for end of follow-up.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosis of a pancreatic cyst
- also pre- or postoperatively
Exclusion criteria:
Patients without follow-up or non-intended follow-up
